title: carex tristachya var. pocilliformis
intro: Carex tristachya var. pocilliformis, commonly known as the horned sedge, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Carex tristachya var. pocilliformis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Carex tristachya var. pocilliformis have been shown to exhibit potential therapeutic benefits, including antimicrobial, antiviral, and anticancer properties.
